findings.title: index.md's doctor check count is stale ("47" vs the actual 49)
locations: docs/src/index.md:49 — "47 read-only checks that a package is wired correctly"
src/CLI/Doctor.jl:96-680 — 49 `check!("ID", ...)` registrations (50 `check!(` lines minus the helper definition at line 96)
findings.description: index.md claims `gbg doctor` runs "47 read-only checks", but counting every `check!("...", ...)` registration in src/CLI/Doctor.jl gives 49 distinct check ids (verified by grepping unique ids). Neither the default run (49 minus the 6-entry DEEP list = 43) nor the `--deep` run (49) equals 47, so the figure is stale under RULE.DOC.CURRENT regardless of which mode is meant.
findings.resolution_hint: Update index.md to state the current count (49 total, or specify "43 by default, 49 with --deep"), and re-measure this number whenever a check is added or removed (RULE.TEST.COUNTS_REMEASURED).

findings.title: index.md mischaracterizes TestHarness's oracle engine as requiring "an independent reference" for every operation
locations: docs/src/index.md:61-62 — "an independent reference for every public value-returning operation"
src/TestHarness.jl:398-401 — "every class is one of `analytic | independent | property | relational | structural`; no operation rests on `relational` alone"
findings.description: `TestHarness.oracle_registry` requires every public value-returning operation to be CLASSIFIED into one of five oracle classes, and only bars `relational`-only coverage; it does not require an independent reference for every operation. A `structural` operation (returns metadata/storage) needs no citation at all (`class == "structural" && continue` before the citation checks), and a `property` oracle is an invariant, not a reference value. The page's plausible-sounding paraphrase overstates the guarantee — exactly the false-but-plausible pattern RULE.DOC.VERIFIED warns against.
findings.resolution_hint: Reword to match RULE.TEST.ORACLE_INDEPENDENT's own framing: "every public value-returning operation classified by oracle provenance (analytic, independent, property, relational or structural), with relational never standing alone".

findings.title: rounds.md's demotion rule names only half of the actual trigger condition
locations: docs/src/guide/rounds.md:42 — "The demotion is mechanical: `HONORED` with an empty `class_surfaces[]` becomes `LINE-ONLY`."
findings.description: `demote()` also demotes a HONORED verdict when `class_surfaces` is non-empty but any entry has `swept == false` — a claimed-but-unswept class sweep. rounds.md's sentence names only the empty-array case, which is a true-but-partial statement of the rule (RULE.DOC.CURRENT: naming only a subset of what the code does is stale even if literally true).
findings.resolution_hint: State both arms: "`HONORED` becomes `LINE-ONLY` when `class_surfaces[]` is empty or any of its entries is not marked `swept`."
